notes.title: Demo Version 1.1 Available
notes.notes:
In the leadup to Next Fest, I've been hard at work trying to make the Magnetron Rebellion: Fully Loaded Demo even better. To that end, I have:

[list]
[*] Added Full Controller Support
[*] Added Mac and Linux Support
[*] Improved the game's particle effects
[*] Added additional color options for the enemy ships and bullets
[*] Added Steam Leaderboard support
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support. The full game releases in July so please look forward to more information as we get closer to launch. Until then, aim the top of the leaderboard!
